strings.grewPhrases: Tomo grew up → {age}. Now it speaks in two-word phrases.
strings.grewTalking: Tomo grew up → {age}. Now it talks with you: pick what it means, or a reply that fits!
strings.answerOwnWords: Answer in your own words: type or tap the mic · {ai}
strings.notNow: Not now: Tomo waits beside the notch
strings.mic.permission: Allow Microphone and Speech Recognition for Tomodachi in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
strings.mic.unavailable: {language} speech recognition isn't available on this Mac.
strings.mic.notInstalled: On-device {language} recognition isn't installed. Add {language} in System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation, or type your answer.
strings.outcome.why.loss: Tomo didn't get it. Try again!
strings.outcome.why.language: Not in {language}: no score, no penalty
strings.outcome.why.help: You asked for help: no score, no penalty
strings.settings.learningNote: Each language you learn has its own Tomo. Progress is saved on this device and synced to your other devices through iCloud.
strings.settings.openAtLogin: Open Tomodachi when you log in
strings.settings.openAtLoginNote: Tomo can only drop in while Tomodachi is open.
strings.settings.openAtLoginApprove: Allow Tomodachi in System Settings → General → Login Items.
strings.settings.restartNote: A new Tomo at level 1. You'll be asked first.
strings.about.tagline: A little friend who only speaks the language you're learning, at its own age.
strings.about.feedback: Tell us what felt fun, confusing, or annoying.
strings.ai.footer: Without a provider, Tomo uses built-in offline replies. The key is stored in your Keychain.
strings.explain.askPlaceholder: Which part? e.g. like to do
strings.explain.noAI: Step-by-step explanations with AI come in a later version.
strings.word.title: Word
strings.levelUp: Level {level}! New words for Tomo to learn.
strings.outcome.why.practice: Practice: it's too soon after the last time to count. Come back later and it counts again.
strings.startOver.title: Start Tomo over?
strings.startOver.body: Your {language} Tomo goes back to level 1, and the words it learned from you are cleared. This can't be undone.
strings.settings.testingNote: Testing runs on a copy of Tomo in memory: trying another age or skipping ahead never changes your saved Tomo. Back to my Tomo ends it.
strings.words.lastLevel: {known} of {needed} words known · the last level for now
strings.words.testing: This is a testing Tomo. Testing → Back to my Tomo.
strings.growth.age.1: A tiny blob, just hatched. Single baby words: tap the picture, or feed, put to bed and hug Tomo.
strings.growth.age.2: Evolves into a new shape. Two-word phrases.
strings.growth.age.3: Evolves again, a little bigger. Talks with you: pick what Tomo means, or a reply that fits.
strings.growth.age.4: Preschool words from everyday talk and picture books.
strings.growth.age.5: More preschool words: feelings, places, how things happen.
strings.growth.age.6: Words children know before starting school.
strings.grewOlder: Tomo grew up → {age}. New words to learn!
strings.practice.offer: Nothing counts until {time}. You can practice, but it won't move the bar.
strings.practice.offer.now: Nothing counts right now. You can practice, but it won't move the bar.
strings.rest.practiceNote: Just for fun: practice won't move the bar
strings.left.last.one: 1 more word to finish the last level
strings.left.last: {n} more words to finish the last level
strings.dizzy: Too many pokes. Tomo is dizzy; back in three seconds.
strings.glance.new: A new word is ready to learn
strings.glance.about: Tomo, and whether anything is waiting.
strings.onboarding.hatch.title: Your Tomo is about to hatch
strings.onboarding.hatch.body: Tomo is a little friend who only speaks {language}. It grows up as you understand it.
strings.onboarding.hello.title: This is your Tomo
strings.onboarding.hello.body: No one else has one like it. It's {age}, so it says single baby words. As you understand them, it grows up, into a new shape at every birthday.
strings.onboarding.round.coach.body: Tomo says a word in {language}. Show it you understood: nothing to type, nothing to say.
strings.onboarding.round.again.title: Not that one
strings.onboarding.round.again.body: Tomo says it again, slower. Listen, and try another one.
strings.onboarding.result.title: You just understood your first {language}.
strings.onboarding.result.stick.title: Built to make it stick
strings.onboarding.result.stick.body: Tomo asks {word} again around {time}, then after longer and longer waits: days, weeks, months. Each time you know it, the word gets stronger, and Tomo grows.
strings.onboarding.result.stick.later: Tomo asks it again in a few hours, then after longer and longer waits: days, weeks, months. Each time you know it, the word gets stronger, and Tomo grows.
strings.onboarding.visits.title: Tomo comes to you
strings.onboarding.visits.body: No need to open an app to study. Every so often Tomo pops out of the notch with a word or two, then goes back.
strings.onboarding.visits.typing: It waits while you type, and skips when you're away.
strings.onboarding.visits.click: Can't wait? Click small Tomo by the notch to play any time.
strings.onboarding.visits.ignore: Busy? Click ×, or just ignore it. Tomo tucks in with a red dot: no streaks, no guilt.
strings.onboarding.rhythm.title: Set your rhythm
strings.onboarding.rhythm.body: How often should Tomo drop in?
strings.onboarding.rhythm.note: A visit brings the words that are due, then one new word at most: up to {n} new words a day. Change it any time in Settings.
strings.onboarding.ready.title: Baby words first
strings.onboarding.ready.note: Tomo pops out of the notch in a moment.
strings.onboarding.back.title: Welcome back
strings.onboarding.back.body: Your Tomo came along from your other device: {age} · Lv {level}. On this Mac it lives by the notch and drops in every so often. Click it any time to play.
strings.settings.languageNote: The language of Tomodachi's buttons and help. Tomo speaks {language}.
strings.about.credit.wordbank.body: When children understand and say each word, for ages 1–3. CC BY 4.0. Frank, Braginsky, Yurovsky & Marchman (2017), Journal of Child Language 44(3). Japanese data: Tsuji; Hagihara et al. (2023); Minagawa (Japanese CDI, Ogura & Watamaki). English data: the MacArthur-Bates CDI norming samples (Fenson, Marchman et al.).
strings.about.credit.ninjal: NINJAL 幼児語彙 and 絵本語彙
strings.about.credit.ninjal.body: Japanese words for ages 3–6, from preschoolers' everyday speech and from picture books. CC BY 4.0. National Institute for Japanese Language and Linguistics: Okubo & Kawamata (1982); Nakasone & Kawamata (1994).
strings.about.credit.jmdict.body: Readings and English meanings for many of the Japanese words. CC BY-SA 4.0. This product uses the JMdict dictionary file, the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, used in conformance with the Group's licence.
strings.about.credit.blobatar.body: Tomo's shapes, and how each learner's look comes from a seed, are adapted from blobatar by Alain. MIT License.
strings.about.credit.coucou.body: The Mac app's notch window is based on Coucou by Louis Raillé. MIT License.
